description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC controller class 'CustomerController' that manages customer-related operations in an admin interface. It includes methods for displaying customer details, saving customer data, listing customers, paginating customer lists, and resetting customer passwords. The class interacts with various services to handle customer data, attributes, options, and email communications, and handles HTTP requests mapped to specific URLs with role-based security annotations.

classes.name: CustomerController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller handling customer management operations such as viewing, editing, listing, and resetting password for customers in the admin interface.

methods.name: displayCustomer
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display customer details form for viewing or editing existing customer, or creating a new customer if no ID is provided.

methods.name: saveCustomer
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save or update customer information, with validation and country/zone processing.

methods.name: displayCustomers
methods.description: Handles GET request to display the customer list page.

methods.name: pageCustomers
methods.description: Handles POST requests to retrieve a paginated list of customers as JSON data for dynamic UI.

methods.name: resetPassword
methods.description: Handles POST requests to reset a customer's password, generate a new one, encode it, save, and email the customer with the new password.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets the active menu context for the admin interface.
